question: In the sentence, 'She gave a succinct summary of the meeting', what is a synonym of the word 'succinct'?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"succinct"** means something expressed in a clear, concise, and brief manner, without unnecessary words. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** Her email response was succinct, covering all key points in just two sentences.
 
 
 
• **"Brief"** refers to something that is short in duration or length, or concise in expression. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher gave a brief explanation of the topic before moving on to the next chapter.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'succinct'** is **'brief'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Brief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lengthy** (लंबा): Something that is long in duration or contains excessive details.

 
 
• **Example:** The lengthy speech bored the audience after the first ten minutes.
 
 
 
• **Complicated** (जटिल): Something that is difficult to understand or requires effort to figure out.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions for assembling the furniture were so complicated that I had to call a professional.
 
 
 
• **Detailed** (विस्तृत): Something that contains a lot of information or goes into depth.
 
 
• **Example:** The report provided a detailed analysis of the company’s financial performance over the last year.
